“秦爷爷，等下午，我就把这孩子送回来....”一处小洋房的面前，林枫左边跟着藤藤蛇，右边跟着穿山鼠，跟秦爷爷打招呼。“行，对了，小林，这只藤藤蛇是你的宝可梦吗？”秦爷爷乐呵呵看着躲在林枫身边的藤藤蛇，好奇的问道。这可让藤藤蛇心中一紧。它可怕待会林枫跟这个人类说出事实的真相，那它就颜面扫地了。呜呜呜...千万不要说呀...“是的，这不是想着有那么大的种植园吗？总得收服一只宝可梦来干活吧？”林枫应和道。“哈哈哈...”秦爷爷被逗笑了。....从秦爷爷家出来后，林枫又在小镇上卖了一份辣番果，这可把跟过来的穿山鼠馋的不行。【精灵：穿山鼠】【性别：雄】【特性：沙隐】【资质：白色】【个体值：HP（14）攻击（15）特攻（12）防御（18）特防（16）速度（11）】【实力：11~12级】【技能：抓，变圆，毒针，泼沙，滚动。】【介绍：一只很容易满足的穿山鼠】【亲密度：65（它对你的感官很好。）】【愉悦值：60（心情不错）】“穿穿~”“别急，这个我待会亲自给你做面吃。”瞧着目不转睛盯着辣番果的穿山鼠，林枫忍俊不禁道。“穿穿...”穿山鼠点了点头，忍不住在路上滚动了起来。这让旁边的藤藤蛇用一脸“没出息”的表情看着它。几个辣番果做成的面，能有多好吃？不如能量方块。再次回到种植园，差不多已经是中午了，林枫也没有第一时间就让穿山鼠去工作，而是来到了厨房。因为常年独自生活的原因，林枫早就练就了一身的好厨艺，家里面的基本食材也还到位。这会再获得了神级培育家知识和相对应的大师级知识，

他也不知道自己做出的东西会多好吃？起锅烧水，将水煮到沸腾后，加入小镇上面买的鸡蛋面。挖上一点猪油，让面吸足汤汁，加入一点基础的调味料...一碗清汤面就煮了出来。当然，这只是第一步而已。将面用碗装好，然后打散几个鸡蛋，倒入已经铺了一层微热的菜籽油的锅中，等定型好迅速捞出，将切好的辣番果切成小丁，中火小炒，直到炒出沙后，再将蛋饼放入其中翻炒一下。金黄色的蛋饼立马被红色的辣番果染红，最后加上一点水淀粉勾芡，倒盖在面上，有些粘稠的辣番面就做好了！【b级美食——辣番面，虽然食材一般，但经过制作者鬼斧神工一般的制造手艺，就变成了一份很不错的美食，毕竟，没人会拒绝一份酸酸辣辣的辣番面不是吗？料理效果：特攻加持，吃下去后，能让宝可梦在一个小时内增加10%的特攻，如果经常吃的话，还能增强宝可梦的特攻哦~】“牛逼....”看着【探查之眼】给出的效果。林枫不由得夸赞了一句。他感觉这次的做法，跟以前也没什么区别，但效果却是天差地别。“来...”林枫低头看向早就进来的穿山鼠，就准备将一碗辣番面端给它。没曾想，自己的脚附近，除了一只穿山鼠外，还有一只藤藤蛇~从它微微张开的嘴巴中流出的液体，还有眼眸中的期待中可以看出，它也等了很久了。“你也想吃吗？”“藤藤！”（想！）没有其它的，就一个字——“真香”藤藤蛇已经忘记了自己刚刚对穿山鼠的看不起。“得....”林枫忍不住笑了笑。他虽然不知道刚刚藤藤蛇的表情，但此刻见着馋嘴的藤藤蛇，也是乐得不行。“来，”将两碗面分成三碗，林枫端到了两只小家伙的身边。穿山鼠不会用筷子，也不管烫不烫，直接用爪子抓起来面条就吃。在吃下第一口的时候，滚烫和酸甜辣的滋味在口腔中迸发，它的眼睛一下子就睁大了起来。接着恨不得将整张脸都埋进面里面。【恭喜宿主让穿山鼠的愉悦值从60%提升到85%，奖励金坷垃十袋，神奇糖果一枚，土沙五百克。】“藤藤？”这架势，把藤藤蛇和林枫都吓了一跳。什么鬼，

"Grandpa Qin, I will send this child back in the afternoon..." In front of a small bungalow, Lin Feng greeted Grandpa Qin with a vine snake on his left and a mountain rat on his right."Okay, by the way, Xiao Lin, is this Vine Snake your Pokémon?" Grandpa Qin looked at the Vine Snake hiding next to Lin Feng happily and asked curiously.This made Teng Teng Snake feel nervous.It was afraid that if Lin Feng told this human the truth, it would be disgraced.Woohoo... don't say that... "Yes, aren't you thinking about having such a big plantation? You have to tame a Pokémon to work on it, right?" Lin Feng agreed."Hahaha..." Grandpa Qin was amused.....After coming out of Grandpa Qin's house, Lin Feng sold a piece of spicy mango in the small town, which made the pangolins who followed him very hungry.[Elf: Pangolin] [Gender: Male] [Characteristics: Sand Hidden] [Qualification: White] [Individual Value: HP (14) Attack (15) Special Attack (12) Defense (18) Special Defense (16) Speed ​​(11)] [Strength: Level 11~12] [Skills: Catch, Circle, Poison Needle, Sand Splash, Rolling.] [Introduction: A pangolin that is easily satisfied] [Intimacy: 65 (It is very good for your senses.)] [Pleasure value: 60 (in a good mood)] "Wear it~" "Don't worry, I will make noodles for you later." Lin Feng couldn't help laughing as he looked at the pangolin who was staring at the spicy fruit."Pull through..." The mountain rat nodded and couldn't help but roll on the road.This made the vine snake next to it look at it with a "promising" expression.How delicious can noodles made from a few spicy bananas be?Not as good as energy cubes.When he returned to the plantation again, it was almost noon. Lin Feng did not let the rock rat go to work immediately, but came to the kitchen.Because he has lived alone for many years, Lin Feng has already developed good cooking skills, and the basic ingredients at home are still in place.This will allow you to gain god-level cultivator knowledge and corresponding master-level knowledge.

He doesn't know how delicious his food will be?Boil water in a pot. After the water boils, add the egg noodles bought in the town.Dig in a little lard, let the noodles soak up the soup, add a little basic seasoning... and you have a bowl of clear soup noodles.Of course, this is just the first step.Put the noodles in a bowl, then beat a few eggs, pour them into a pan that has been covered with a layer of slightly heated rapeseed oil, take it out quickly after it is set, cut the chopped spicy tomatoes into small dices, stir-fry over medium heat until the sand is fried, then put the egg cake in it and stir-fry.The golden egg cake is immediately dyed red by the red spicy banana. Finally, add a little water starch to thicken it, pour it over the surface, and the sticky spicy noodles are ready![B-level delicacy - Spicy Noodles. Although the ingredients are average, the maker's uncanny craftsmanship has turned it into a very good delicacy. After all, no one would refuse a sour and spicy Spicy Noodles, right?Cooking effect: Special attack blessing. After eating, it can increase the Pokémon's special attack by 10% within an hour. If you eat it regularly, it can also enhance the Pokémon's special attack~] "Awesome..." Looking at the effect given by [Exploration Eye].Lin Feng couldn't help but praise.He felt that what he did this time was no different from before, but the effect was completely different."Come on..." Lin Feng lowered his head to look at the pangolin who had come in early, and was about to give it a bowl of spicy noodles.I never thought that besides a pangolin, there was also a vine snake near my feet. From the liquid flowing out of its slightly opened mouth and the anticipation in its eyes, it could be seen that it had been waiting for a long time."Do you want to eat too?" "Teng Teng!" (Think!) There is no other word, just one word - "really fragrant". Teng Teng Snake has forgotten that he just looked down on the pangolin rat."Yeah..." Lin Feng couldn't help but smile.Although he didn't know the expression on the Vine Snake just now, he was extremely happy to see the greedy Vine Snake at this moment."Here," Lin Feng divided the two bowls of noodles into three bowls and brought them to the two little guys.The pangolin doesn't know how to use chopsticks, and it doesn't care whether it's hot or not. It just grabs the noodles with its paws and eats them.When he took the first bite, the hot, sweet and sour taste burst out in his mouth, and his eyes suddenly opened wide.Then I wanted to bury my whole face in it.[Congratulations to the host for increasing the pleasure value of the pangolin from 60% to 85%. The reward is ten bags of golden garbage, a magical candy, and 500 grams of soil and sand."Teng Teng?" This posture startled both Teng Teng Snake and Lin Feng.What the hell?
